title: Security Carnival
subtitle: The Rattenfanger atop the Eternal Heights remained tireless. He needed no sleep nor rest.

trails.title: Trail ① Hello, Ms. Sonetto
trails.description: This is the place where Sonetto and Sotheby met in the most unforgettable way.

trails.title: Trail ② Tactic to Disarm
trails.description: A record on the use of hooks and ropes. Disarm will disable the enemy's attack-type arcane skills and stop their attacks to sway the battle in your favor.

items.text: Security Carnival

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Finally, we are safe now.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Thank you very much for your help, Ms. Druvis.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: You ran a long way into the woods. Are you looking for the girl with orange hair?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Yes.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: I "see" her get rid of the critters, and take a dark green Bentley to the northwest.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: The woods know where the visitors go, leading them astray, or to the light.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: And your friend, she has good fortune.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The exit on the northwest ... It's quite close to The Walden on the map.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: The Walden?

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: Now I see. You are also here for the Storm Gathering tonight.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: What is the Storm Gathering?

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: It is a gathering of elite arcanists from all states. Besides, celebrities and frequenters familiar with the barkeeper are also invited.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: I think ... there will be the regular duel performances, a banquet that is too noisy, and the announcement of "good news."

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Do you know what exactly the "good news" is, Ms. Druvis?

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: My apologies. I am not interested in that.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: Hmm ... but if you want to know the "good news," you might as well take my invitation and take a look.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: This is a secret gathering in a speakeasy. It's by invitation only ... and a stock coupon of at least 50,000 dollars is needed.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Stock? Why does it always have something to do with financial securities ...

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: We had a subscription agreement before, but ... it was burned by our friend ...

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: ... That's all right. But you can actually get here with nothing.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: "Stock prices have reached what looks like a permanently high plateau." Have you heard about this?

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: Nowadays, cash is not used for transactions. The application of arcanum has made stock exchange surprisingly convenient.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: The urban agglomerations expand rapidly in the new era, and even the critters have lost their home. Only loans and the infinitely soaring stock market could satisfy such a huge desire.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: It is similar to the history this APPLe knows, but sounds a little different ...

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: ... This is the Gift Agreement for the 50,000 US dollars coupon. If you're still going to the gathering, take it with you.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: You are not going?

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: Thank you for asking, but I ... do not want to leave the woods for now.
Sign the real name.

items.speaker: Stockbroker
items.text: Hello, I am your personal stockbroker. Your grantee application has been received ... Application approved ... Account updated.

items.speaker: Stockbroker
items.text: Thank you for your support to blue-chip stock.

items.speaker: Stockbroker
items.text: The real estate market is on fire today. Now we have customized recommendations for you …

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: We're good, thank you.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: The exit of the woods is at the end of the road, next to the three cypresses. I will leave you here then. May the woods bless you with fortune.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: And ...

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: ... If you see the barkeeper, please send him my best regards.
Lord Forget Me Not, you had a good day.
Walden

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: The men I need, have you brought them back?
M-hmm ... Seven arcanists, not even missing a single cutie finger.
They are all very interested in the doctrine of the Manus. Soon, they will become your devout desperados.
I did my job so perfectly. What rewards will there be for me? Heh heh.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: I heard that you didn't take care of the redundancies.
Hmm, I don't really remember ... in the mission, there are instructions to kill civilians.
Or say ... for you, the arcanists who are not pure-blooded are just worthless? Heh Heh.
Even if we are from a southern mafia, we do care about brotherhood. We can't be as ruthless as the "Storm."

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: For the special ones, of course we Manus will make exceptions. Just like now, we are still searching for your missing sister, Schneider.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Thank you for being considerate.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: She strolls lazily towards the door.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Your stepsister Marian must be extremely touched if she knows how much you value her.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: You were adopted by the Grecos after all. It's not like you are related to those ... humans by blood.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: No matter what, we are "families" and have lived together for more than ten years.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Although I think I’ve never mentioned ... which sister is missing.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Mamma.

items.speaker: Schneider
items.text: Mamma, pack up. Let's leave tonight.
TO BE CONTINUED…
